identity.real_world_identity_notes: Maserati identifies the MC12 GT1 as using a manually operated sequential gearbox, distinct from the electro-actuated system of the later Versione Corse. AMS2 visibly models the manual sequential lever without paddles.

wheel_rim.notes: Direct cockpit inspection showed a D-shaped rim without an integrated display; exact diameter remains unknown.

notes: With Auto Clutch disabled, the car stalled when moving from rest without physical clutch input.
All six sequential-stick gears accepted clutch-free full-throttle upshifts with perceptible automatic cut.
Clutch-free downshifts were accepted and no automatic throttle blip was observed; authentic rev matching therefore requires the driver to blip the throttle manually.
The exact Low Downforce identity inherits the verified base controls as an approved aero-package assumption and was not separately live-tested.
Base car live-tested in AMS2 1.6.9.91 with Auto Clutch disabled.
Six-speed sequential-stick actuation, standing-start clutch, automatic cut, no automatic blip, and the D-shaped no-display rim were directly observed.

confidence.basis: Exact base identity and simulator technique were directly tested; manufacturer evidence independently establishes manual sequential actuation.
